title: tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction
why_read: A niche but concrete tool for improving how Claude Code manages long conversation context by scoring and pruning tool-call history instead of summarizing it.
analysis: This is a plugin for Claude Code (Anthropic's coding assistant) that changes how the tool handles running out of context space: instead of compressing old messages into a lossy summary, it scores each tool call and result for relevance and either drops, truncates, or keeps them verbatim. This is a practical engineering approach to a real pain point in long AI coding sessions, where summarization can lose important detail. The idea of selective retention versus blanket summarization is a reasonable technical contribution, though it's a fairly narrow tool aimed at a specific developer workflow.
